# NCTQ Policy Content

> This is a temporary Markdown index for Compass policy content until NCTQ publishes canonical policy pages.

Compass should use these files as structured source content, not as general background reading. Select the topic and requested layer before injecting content into an answer.

## Source Documents

- District Policy Stances: https://docs.google.com/document/d/13RvhrLNmEDjAZaOFzjXzmZm0WEbSonh42jTQOTG1onU/edit?tab=t.0
- Research rationales for Starling: https://docs.google.com/document/d/182nNO91oGow4yiOVL-z5-hni9ZBrl-fmgt-0zE37Ylg/edit?tab=t.0
- Exemplary Policies: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ADYojeXd1qZjleFIdpaRLtz_R6E6iNPJkUytTXb2TEQ/edit?tab=t.fwwto1ul62ol

## Layer Selection

- Use `stances` when the user asks what NCTQ believes, recommends, supports, opposes, or thinks is good policy.
- Use `research_rationales` when the user asks why, what the research says, what evidence supports a position, or asks for the research basis.
- Use `exemplary_policies` when the user asks for a district, example, model, exemplar, who does this well, or a concrete implementation.
- Use multiple layers only when the user asks for a full explanation or when a concise answer needs both an NCTQ position and a district example.

## Citation Rules

- Exemplary district policies must cite their `source_url`.
- Research rationales marked `needs_source_url` should be attributed to NCTQ but should not be presented as externally sourced research until a public source URL is attached.
- Do not present a national stance or rationale as if it were a specific district policy.
- Do not present an exemplary district policy as if it were a statistical finding across all covered districts.

## Topic Alias Notes

- Performance pay is a subtopic of Differentiated Pay in the current source data.
- Teacher Leave is represented as `Leave` in the legacy rationale and exemplar tables.
- Differentiated Compensation is represented as `Differentiated Pay` in the legacy rationale and exemplar tables.
